notes: Printed names: 'LAKEWOOD AV. (GREENWOOD AV.)' (old name Greenwood in brackets), 'W. ST. CLAIR', 'W. ROCHELLE', 'HOPSON', 'BISHOP' (south of St Clair marked '(NOT OPEN)'), 'IMPERIAL', 'ANTONIA (NOT OPEN)', 'FOUNTAIN', 'SCIOTO'; suffix-less names written with 'Street'. Bishop is 50 ft north of St Clair and 60 ft south of it. Hopson (30 ft) runs the whole height along the Burnet Woods edge; at St Clair its west line breaks and two curved park-drive kerbs flare off into Burnet Woods (park drive, not recorded, so Hopson/St Clair is a T). St Clair has two offset pairs of T's: Antonia (40 ft, south side) is ~135 px west of Imperial (50 ft, north side); Scioto (60 ft, south side) is ~260 px west of Fountain (50 ft, north side). Imperial continues north across Lakewood onto 267 (to Nixon). Antonia ends at Rochelle (block 2 of sheet 263 is opposite). Lakewood's north kerb is continuous at Fountain and curves gently down to the east; a narrow (~16 ft) alley leaves Lakewood northward at x~5425 (only a stub on this sheet; it runs onto 267). Bishop, Scioto and Hopson continue south onto 263; St Clair, Rochelle and Lakewood continue east onto 266/268.
